race.comment: BREECHES (11) has been in good form this prep, and she produced another solid effort when finishing third over 1000m at this course last start nearly 4 weeks ago. She saves her best for this track and trip, and she is the one to beat in this. MINNIE VEGAS (14) arrives off a confidence-boosting victory at Mackay where she led all the way, and she carries a kilo less this time. She cops another wide gate, and should be very competitive again. SHE'S SPEEDY (5) has been well supported at her past couple of outings but hasn't quite delivered, although she has not had all favours in those runs. Ryan Wiggins sticks with her, and so do we. PENROD (13) has struggled to find some good form since winning his maiden win here in May, but he can go better, and should be allowed another chance. EXOLENT CHOICE (1) has failed to fire in his last couple of starts, but he gets a superior draw this time, and a form reversal would be no surprise. Each way.
